# Una Meredith

## Overview

- **Age:** Ten years old  <sub>[v5 c2 P34](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0034), [v5 c4 P26](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0026)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v5 c2 P34](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0034)</sub>
- **Origin:** Maywater  <sub>[v5 c4 P46](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0046)</sub>

## Appearance

Una is a sweet, small girl who is not considered pretty. She has straight, dead-black hair worn in braids, tiny white teeth, and almond-shaped dark-blue eyes with a wistful, sorrowful expression. Her mouth has a habit of falling open, and a shy, meditative smile occasionally touches her face.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P34](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0034), [v5 c4 P7](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0007)_

## Personality

Una is a dreamy, sweet, and tender-hearted girl who is deeply sensitive, quiet, and soft-spoken. She is acutely conscious of public opinion and feels anxious about her family's unconventional living conditions, constantly wishing to put things right. Pious and fond of prayer, she hates fighting and possesses a compassionate, sympathetic nature full of pure pity for others. Shy by nature, asking favors of people causes her great distress.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P34](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0034), [v5 c4 P7](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0007), [v5 c5 P3](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0003), [v5 c5 P27](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0027), [v5 c9 P10](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0010), [v5 c17 P23](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0023), [v5 c23 P4](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0004), [v5 c23 P16](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0016)_

## Goals

- To take music lessons  <sub>[v5 c4 P51](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0051)</sub>
- To learn practical domestic skills like cooking, sewing, and knitting  <sub>[v5 c5 P3](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0003)</sub>
- To make her father happy  <sub>[v5 c33 P36](../source/v05-c33.md#nw-v05-c33-p0036), [v5 c34 P31](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0031)</sub>

## History

Una moved with her family from Maywater to the Glen St. Mary manse. She became close friends with the Ingleside children and befriended Mary Vance after helping feed and shelter her at the manse. Despite her extreme shyness, she mustered the courage to visit Mrs. Elliott to ask her to adopt Mary. Later, Mrs. Alec Davis approached her father attempting to adopt Una, but Mr. Meredith refused. Following a church incident, Una participated in a day-long fast as a punishment dictated by the Good-Conduct Club, during which she fainted from exhaustion and was rescued by Dr. Gilbert Blythe. Distressed by fear of a cruel stepmother, Una's anxiety was transformed when she overheard her father's grief over his feelings for Rosemary West; she secretly visited Rosemary to ask her to marry her father, securing Rosemary's warm promise to be a friend and helper.

_Sources: [v5 c4 P45](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0045), [v5 c4 P46](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0046), [v5 c5 P27](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0027), [v5 c9 P10](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0010), [v5 c14 P17](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0017), [v5 c14 P18](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0018), [v5 c25 P14](../source/v05-c25.md#nw-v05-c25-p0014), [v5 c28 P1](../source/v05-c28.md#nw-v05-c28-p0001), [v5 c28 P16](../source/v05-c28.md#nw-v05-c28-p0016), [v5 c28 P21](../source/v05-c28.md#nw-v05-c28-p0021), [v5 c33 P36](../source/v05-c33.md#nw-v05-c33-p0036), [v5 c34 P5](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0005), [v5 c34 P31](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0031)_
